chunking: diff 3816 lines > ~3000 → 2 chunks by top-level dir: chunk1 app/ (9 files, 2952 lines), chunk2 harness/+goldens/+ci/stories/memlog (7 files, 880 lines); one 7-lens wave per chunk, sequential

findings.title: Phase-2 keys (X/DEL/U/1/2/E/S/B) act on frames the old handle_input early-returned from — same-frame right-click+X demolishes the pipe the right-click just selected
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin:217-236 (unconditional phase-2 loop) + app/input/exec.odin:134-149 (Demolish gate) vs a4d6e9e:app/main.odin (right-branch `return`)
findings.detail: Old handle_input `return`ed inside the right-press branch (and on popover/QoS/tray-swallowed left-presses), so X/DEL/U/1/2/E/S/B were IGNORED on those frames. The new mapping emits phase-2 key intents unconditionally; the executor re-checks only placing/drag, which Right_Click has already cleared. Same-frame right-click+X: old = select only; new = select + DEMOLISH the just-selected pipe. Same for swallowed left-press+X. A mouse-path behavioral delta — the round's ONE hard blocker (mouse preserved EXACTLY, FORGE #6/ODN-12).
findings.recommended_fix: In mouse_map, suppress phase-2 key intents on frames with a right-press or a UI/tray-swallowed left-press (mirroring the old early returns), and add same-frame right-press+X and ESC+press T1 cases.

findings.title: Same-frame ESC + left-press while placing diverges from the old mouse path (no drag starts; the release is swallowed)
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin:63-76,148-181 (has_left branch) + app/input/exec.odin:45-58 (Cancel) vs a4d6e9e:app/main.odin (cancel block ran BEFORE the press block)
findings.detail: Old code cancelled placement FIRST (placing=-1, press_swallowed=true), then the press block re-anchored, RESET press_swallowed=false, ran the popover/QoS checks and started a drag (snap_node) — the release then committed or click-selected. The new mapping evaluates the press branch on PRE-execution placing (still >=0), so no Begin_Draw and no UI checks run; the executor's Cancel then sets press_swallowed=true, suppressing the later release entirely. Deterministic, scriptable mouse-path delta; input_parity_cancel scripts ESC alone, so the corner is unpinned.
findings.recommended_fix: In mouse_map, when esc_cancelled, decide the left-press branch on the post-cancel state (treat placing as -1, mirroring the old sequential order) and re-clear press_swallowed after the Cancel executes; add an ESC+press same-frame scenario to input_parity_cancel.

findings.title: input_parity_right_click asserts nothing about the right-click SELECT — the W3/W5 transcription is unpinned
findings.location: harness/parity.odin:521-547 (scenario 11) vs check_states (parity.odin:654-699 — no right_click case)
findings.detail: The scenario comment promises `no commands, sel_pipe == 0`, but only the Draw command stream is asserted; check_states has no input_parity_right_click case. A broken right-click effect (no select, wrong pipe, missed drag-interrupt) passes the gate green — on the hard-blocker mouse surface.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a check_states case asserting the mouse run's sel_pipe == 0, sel_node == -1 (and drag cleared / swallow set) after the right press.

findings.title: Same-frame duplicate phase-1 keys break the old || semantics: P+Space double-flips pause (net no-op), R+Enter double-restarts at Game_Over
findings.location: app/input/poll.odin:53-56 (per-key events) + app/input/mouse.odin:64-75 (one Toggle_Pause per event) + exec.odin Toggle_Pause/Retry
findings.detail: poll_mouse appends one Key_Press per key, and the mapping emits one intent per event: same-frame P+Space toggles pause TWICE (Run stays Run; old single `||` block paused), R+Enter restarts twice. Rare (<16ms chord) but deterministic and scriptable.
findings.recommended_fix: Coalesce phase-1 toggles per frame (emit at most one Toggle_Pause / Retry per frame, matching the old `||` coalescing).

findings.title: Touch presses bypass the app-UI swallow: draws can start/commit through the demolish popover + QoS panel, and the popover buttons are touch-dead
findings.location: app/input/touch.odin:31-45 (Touch_Press never calls inp.on_ui_press; only mouse_map does)
findings.detail: A touch press landing on the demolish popover (anchored at the selected node) begins a draw; sliding to another node commits it — the popover/QoS swallow only runs in the mouse path, so the buttons never fire for touch. New-surface defect (not a mouse-parity issue), but it ships with the story's touch mapping.
findings.recommended_fix: Route Touch_Press through the same on_ui_press swallow before Begin_Draw (the popover-first order), as the mouse path does.

findings.title: One shared drag slot has no gesture ownership — a touch press or pad A can hijack/commit an in-progress mouse drag
findings.location: app/input/exec.odin:182-197 (begin_draw overwrites unconditionally), 215-224 (Confirm); app/input/input.odin:115-129 (fixed dispatch order)
findings.detail: All three devices share one drag state; begin_draw overwrites it unconditionally. A finger tap mid-mouse-drag re-anchors the drag at the touch node (the mouse's later release then commits the re-anchored draw at the mouse position); pad A commits whatever drag is active. Deterministic dispatch makes it reproducible; T1 drives one device per run, so the path is untested.
findings.recommended_fix: Add gesture ownership (first device to begin a drag owns it until release/cancel) or reject Begin_Draw/Confirm while another device's drag is active.

findings.title: mouse_map allocates + frees a heap dynamic every frame — per-frame heap churn in the input hot path
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin:56-57,93 (moves dynamic + defer delete) + poll.odin:78 (Mouse_Move emitted every frame)
findings.detail: poll_mouse appends a Mouse_Move every frame, so mouse_map's moves buffer heap-allocates and frees each frame. Violates project-context.md:63 'zero per-frame heap churn (frame arena)'. events/intents avoid this by persisting on Input; moves is the only per-frame dynamic.
findings.recommended_fix: Persist the moves scratch on Input (like events/intents) and clear it per frame, or use a small stack array.

findings.title: Controller B (Cancel/Cancel_Drag) and Start (Toggle_Pause) have zero scenario coverage; Cancel_Drag is brand-new executor code
findings.location: harness/parity.odin pad scripts (only .A/.Dpad_Down/.L_Bumper/.R_Bumper scripted — grep-verified); app/input/exec.odin:61-67 (Cancel_Drag)
findings.detail: The pad's escape hatch (B mid-drag → Cancel_Drag, B deselect, Start pause) is new intent-branch code with no pin; a broken B (drag stranded) ships untested.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a pad scenario: A begins a draw, B aborts (assert no command, drag cleared, no stray select); Start toggles pause.

findings.title: No negative/validation-rejection scenario — the Command-stage rejection plumbing (last_reject/reject_tick toast) is happy-path-only proven
findings.location: harness/parity.odin:330-535 (all 11 scenarios expect success) vs app/input/exec.odin:254-262,424-434 (err != .None branches)
findings.detail: The round guard 'invalid/out-of-contract intents are rejected, not silently dropped' is only verified by reading the code: every scenario's commands succeed, so the rejection-surfacing path never executes under test.
findings.recommended_fix: Add negative scenarios: terminal-to-terminal draw / occupied-tile place / demolish with no selection — assert no log entry + last_reject/reject_tick set.

findings.title: Game_Over retry surface (R/Enter mouse keys, pad A) and the pause toggle (P/Space/Start) are never driven through the intent layer
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin:31-40 (Game_Over gate); harness/parity.odin (no mode/pause/retry scenario; fixture never enters Game_Over)
findings.detail: The terminal-run path (the only Game_Over input) and the mode flips could regress silently; a stale-state retry leak (ODN-13) would be invisible headless.
findings.recommended_fix: Add scenarios: P toggles mode; R/Enter + pad A at ictx.mode=.Game_Over reach on_retry; non-A pad buttons are inert at Game_Over.

findings.title: Mouse transcription branches unpinned: pause/assist/overlay/preview keys, ESC-deselect, right-while-placing (W3), drag-interrupt swallow
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin:64-75,120-130,224-240; harness/parity.odin roster
findings.detail: The hard blocker is exact mouse preservation, yet 7 transcribed branches produce no intent in any scenario. The W3 right-while-placing transcription (Cancel + Right_Click) and the drag-interrupt swallow never execute. This is exactly the class of corner where the two confirmed blockers were found.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend the roster: right press while placing (placement cleared + pipe selected), right press mid-drag (swallow + no re-select), ESC deselect, U preview arm.

findings.title: pad_step boundary cases untested: Dpad_Up first-placement, wrap-around, dead-node skipping never run
findings.location: app/input/exec.odin:527-559 (pad_step); harness scripts only Dpad_Down from unset (+1 steps)
findings.detail: The wrap (idx %= n), the -1 first-placement branch, and the alive-scan never execute under test — despite an explicit edge-hunter fix (finding 3) living in that arithmetic.
findings.recommended_fix: Script Dpad_Up first-placement (lands on last node), wrap past both ends, and a step that skips demolished nodes.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL (calibrated to warning per round guards — the concerns are realized by blockers B1/B2)
findings.location: harness/parity.odin (scenario matrix)
findings.detail: Both chunk reviews independently returned gate FAIL: the across-inputs T1 pin exists and is real (command + hash streams asserted equal per scenario + 2 blessed manifests + CI step), but P1 breadth (rejections, pad B/Start, pause/retry, same-frame executor gates, right-click edges) is untested — and the two confirmed blockers sit exactly in those unpinned corners.
findings.recommended_fix: Land the blocker fixes WITH their pinning scenarios (same-frame right-press+X, ESC+press, negative rejections, pad B), then deliberately re-bless.

findings.title: key_map in poll.odin is defined but never called
findings.location: app/input/poll.odin:21-41
findings.detail: poll_mouse inlines every raylib→semantic key translation; grep confirms zero callers. Dead code in the new package (pad_map, by contrast, is used by poll_controller).
findings.recommended_fix: Delete key_map or route poll_mouse through it.

findings.title: Pad cursor can point at a demolished node: Confirm aims from a dead id resolved via node_pos[0]
findings.location: app/input/exec.odin:431-440 (node_pos drops node_slot's ok) + Confirm/pad_step; demolish_* never clear pad_node
findings.detail: Demolishing the cursor node leaves pad_node stale; Confirm's node_world reads node_pos[0] — a wrong anchor. validate_draw rejects (Missing_Node), so no corruption, but every A press silently no-ops until a dpad step re-arms.
findings.recommended_fix: Clear pad_has/pad_node when the cursor node dies (demolish paths), or re-resolve before Confirm.

findings.title: A touch press clears the mouse press's swallow latch mid-frame, letting a later mouse release re-select
findings.location: app/input/touch.odin:35 (press_swallowed = false unconditionally) + input.odin dispatch order
findings.detail: A mouse press swallowed by the popover (latch=true) plus any touch press in the same frame clears the latch; the mouse's release then click-selects, defeating the 'must never re-select' swallow contract. Mixed-device same-frame corner.
findings.recommended_fix: Only reset the latch for the device that owns the current press gesture.

findings.title: Pad aim-commit never invokes on_drag_update — the R3 glow preview never lights for pad draws
findings.location: app/input/exec.odin Confirm aim path (drag_retarget + commit_draw call no preview hook) vs effect_drag_update doc 'and the pad aim step'
findings.detail: preview_live stays false from begin_draw for pad draws, so on_draw_commit skips the glow copy. View-only assist divergence (no command difference); the app's effect doc claims the pad aim step runs it.
findings.recommended_fix: Call on_drag_update after the Confirm-path drag_retarget (or fix the doc).

findings.title: Pad B while placement is armed routes to Cancel_Drag: the ghost hides but placing stays armed
findings.location: app/input/controller.odin:45-53 (.B) + exec.odin Cursor_Move placement branch (sets drag.active while placing)
findings.detail: B is documented as the ESC twin, but per-frame mouse moves while placing set drag.active=true, so B hits Cancel_Drag — placing stays >= 0 and a later left release places a router the B-press was meant to cancel. ESC (Cancel) is unaffected; needs mouse+pad both live.
findings.recommended_fix: Gate the .B branch on an ACTIVE DRAW (drag.active && placing < 0) so B always disarms placement like ESC.

findings.title: Four unused imports in the new app/input package (compile-clean on the pinned nightly, dead baggage)
findings.location: app/input/exec.odin:18 (core:fmt); app/input/touch.odin:17 (rl); app/input/controller.odin:17-18 (rl, pp) — grep-verified, only comment references
findings.detail: The pinned nightly tolerates unused imports (lens build-verified), but a stricter toolchain would fail and the imports are dead weight.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the four imports.

findings.title: Demolish: node flavor, Delete key, and the same-frame executor gate (X mid-drag suppression) untested
findings.location: harness/parity.odin:481-496 (pipe flavor with X only); app/input/exec.odin:134-145
findings.detail: Cmd_Demolish_Node (the E27 batch), the Delete key twin, and the same-frame press+X suppression never execute at the input layer.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a junction demolish scenario and a same-frame press+X case asserting suppression.

findings.title: T1 goldens are first-blessed in this PR; 'mouse preserved exactly' has no pre-change baseline
findings.location: goldens/input_parity_draw.t1, input_parity_draw_wide.t1 (new); harness/parity.odin:624-633
findings.detail: The goldens pin the NEW mouse behavior; the pre-5.4 handle_input was not headless-testable, so exactness rests on transcription review (this review found two deltas) plus the explicit expected streams. The pins themselves are live cross-device equality assertions, not just re-blesses — the guard's verification item passes.
findings.recommended_fix: None possible retroactively; keep the explicit expected streams as the semantic pin.

findings.title: parity_right_click_effect hand-duplicates the app's effect_right_click — the pin covers a harness copy, not the app handler
findings.location: harness/parity.odin:109-129 vs app/main.odin:625-641 (bodies verified identical today)
findings.detail: The one transcribed behavior not moved into the shared executor is exactly the one the harness had to copy; the two bodies must be hand-synced and drift silently decays the pin.
findings.recommended_fix: Move the right-click body into app/input with explicit args (the snap_node/click_select pattern); effect_right_click and the parity hook both delegate.

findings.title: Mixed-device frames never scripted: the fixed mouse→touch→controller dispatch order is unexercised
findings.location: app/input/input.odin:115-129; app/main.odin:518-522 (one merged frame); harness runs one device per run
findings.detail: The app merges all three pollers into one frame, but every scenario scripts one device alone — the cross-device same-frame interactions (the drag-hijack and latch-clear findings) stay invisible to CI.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a mixed-device scenario once gesture ownership is decided.

findings.title: Effect hooks pass an untyped rawptr user — a departure from the events-not-callbacks convention (ODN-14)
findings.location: app/input/input.odin:70-80; app/main.odin:559; project-context.md:42
findings.detail: Eleven app-effect proc hooks + a rawptr user form the app<->input contract; a miscast user compiles clean and corrupts at runtime. Pragmatic (input cannot import package main) and documented, but the one untyped seam in a strongly typed layer.
findings.recommended_fix: None required now; if a second consumer appears, consider a typed context struct.

findings.title: The input package now hosts QoS business rules + selection/demolish command production — UI (qos_panel) depends on it
findings.location: app/input/exec.odin:457-497 (set_lane_class/qos_apply_auto moved from qos_panel); app/qos_panel.odin:5
findings.detail: Structurally motivated (the harness cannot import package main) and acyclic, but the package's scope now spans mapping, hit-testing, selection UX, and QoS domain logic.
findings.recommended_fix: Acceptable for the slice; revisit if the package grows further.

findings.title: class_cycle mouse leg is vacuous: sel_class preset 0 + .One SETs 0, so a dropped key still passes
findings.location: harness/parity.odin:429-436 (preset sel_class = 0) + 683-685 (assert == 0)
findings.detail: The mouse SET writes the value the state already holds; only the pad leg (bumper wrap 0→1) is a real pin.
findings.recommended_fix: Preset sel_class = 1 so the .One SET must visibly change state.

findings.title: Scenario frame scripts leak their [dynamic][]Device_Event backings
findings.location: harness/parity.odin:563-570 (defer frees inner slices + expected, never sc.mouse/touch/pad backings)
findings.detail: frames() heap-allocates each scenario's dynamic backing; ~11x3 small backings leak in a one-shot CLI. Trivial.
findings.recommended_fix: Also delete(sc.mouse)/delete(sc.touch)/delete(sc.pad) in the cleanup defer.

rejected_findings.title: cmd_equal compares only apply_tick + kind — wrong command payloads pass
rejected_findings.reason: FALSE POSITIVE: `a.kind == b.kind` on Odin unions compares the tag AND the payload; all Command_Kind variants are plain comparable structs (weights is [3]i32). Verified against core/types.odin:58-64,127 — the expected-stream check is payload-aware.
